recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It preserves the historical FHIR-5547 fix without reviving an obsolete core XML Tools zip and aligns current pages with the later decision to remove stale in-spec tool downloads; future tooling inventories should be maintained in the referenced Confluence/tooling registries unless FHIR-I explicitly reintroduces a core download.
issue_request: FHIR-5547 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and reported that the XML Tools zip linked from the downloads page was corrupt; it also asked whether the document rendering stylesheet in that zip had been updated to use Bundle resources for FHIR documents.
initial_application: The historical corruption fix is present in git-svn commit 5d8921e1b92ab1c33853a4d87685fc1a8031e7a2, whose message is '#5547 xml tools file corrupt' and whose git-svn-id records SVN revision 4006, matching the Jira comment. The old Java implementation tree that contained the changed Utilities.path helper is no longer part of the current core checkout.
additional_context: Later FHIR-30088 and FHIR-31735 decisions moved mutable tool and reference implementation listings from core source to Confluence-backed registries. The downloads page no longer includes XML Tools or a refimpl anchor, and a Zulip implementation thread for FHIR-31735 records Grahame Grieve saying the dead XML Tools URL should be removed. FHIR-30088 and FHIR-31735 are already represented on the combined branch, so they were cited as related context rather than decided again.
reconciliation: Updated active build pages to remove all remaining downloads.html#refimpl/XML Tools source references: documents now points implementers to implementation support resources for rendering tooling, validation now describes using an ISO Schematron processor rather than a nonexistent XML Tools download, and resource-formats now points to implementation support resources for XML/JSON conversion libraries.
source_changes: source/documents.html: replaced the obsolete XML Tools reference implementation sentence with guidance to use implementation tooling and the implementation support page.
source/validation.html: replaced the XML Tools download reference with ISO Schematron processor guidance for running Schematron.
source/resource-formats.html: replaced the downloads.html#refimpl reference platforms link with implementation support guidance for FHIR libraries that handle XML/JSON conversion.

related_jiras.note: Its R5 application removed downloads-page Reference Implementations rows, including XML Tools and the refimpl anchor, in favor of Confluence-maintained implementation listings; already audited on the combined branch.

Its R5 application moved validation/tool-specific documentation to the FHIR Tools Registry, and its Zulip implementation discussion explicitly supported removing the dead XML Tools URL; already audited on the combined branch.
